# Section 13.3 — plan/generate plan_sha256 byte-equality (REQ-033).
# Process-boundary: real foundry binary; plan JSON plan_sha256 must equal
# generate's recorded plan_sha256 under identical flags.
#
# Destinations use $EQ_ROOT (0700 under sticky /tmp) — $WORK is not custody-safe.

# --- default verify (minimal-cli) ---
mkdir $EQ_ROOT/parent
chmod 0700 $EQ_ROOT/parent

exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $EQ_ROOT/parent/minimal-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"plan_sha256"'
! stderr .
cp stdout plan_default.json
dump_digest plan_default.json

exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $EQ_ROOT/parent/minimal-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"commit_outcome":"committed"'
stdout '"plan_sha256"'
! stderr .
cp stdout gen_default.json
dump_digest gen_default.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_default.json gen_default.json
exists $EQ_ROOT/parent/minimal-cli/go.mod

# --- strict verify: both change step list identically ---
mkdir $EQ_ROOT/parent-strict
chmod 0700 $EQ_ROOT/parent-strict

exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $EQ_ROOT/parent-strict/minimal-cli --verify strict --output json
stdout '"mode":"strict"'
stdout 'go-staticcheck'
stdout 'go-govulncheck'
! stderr .
cp stdout plan_strict.json

exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $EQ_ROOT/parent-strict/minimal-cli --verify strict --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"committed"'
! stderr .
cp stdout gen_strict.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_strict.json gen_strict.json
assert_plan_sha256_ne plan_default.json plan_strict.json

# --- smoke-cli fixture (integration golden source) ---
mkdir $EQ_ROOT/parent-smoke
chmod 0700 $EQ_ROOT/parent-smoke

exec foundry plan --spec fixtures/foundry-smoke-cli/foundry.toml --dest $EQ_ROOT/parent-smoke/foundry-smoke-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
! stderr .
cp stdout plan_smoke.json

exec foundry generate --spec fixtures/foundry-smoke-cli/foundry.toml --dest $EQ_ROOT/parent-smoke/foundry-smoke-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"committed"'
! stderr .
cp stdout gen_smoke.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_smoke.json gen_smoke.json
exists $EQ_ROOT/parent-smoke/foundry-smoke-cli/go.mod

# --- --dest override recorded identically ---
mkdir $EQ_ROOT/parent-dest
chmod 0700 $EQ_ROOT/parent-dest

exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $EQ_ROOT/parent-dest/minimal-cli --output json
stdout 'parent-dest/minimal-cli'
! stderr .
cp stdout plan_dest.json

exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $EQ_ROOT/parent-dest/minimal-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout 'parent-dest/minimal-cli'
! stderr .
cp stdout gen_dest.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_dest.json gen_dest.json
exists $EQ_ROOT/parent-dest/minimal-cli/go.mod
